version.changelog:
No user-facing changes detected in this release.

- Version bump only; no source or documentation changes present.

llm.summary: The skill's purpose and instructions (ERC-4337 account management) are coherent, but the registry metadata requires signer and dashboard credentials unconditionally even though the SKILL.md states those are conditional—this mismatch is disproportionate and should be clarified before use.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (create/fund/manage ERC-4337 smart accounts) match the actions described in SKILL.md (RPC access, contract calls, signing flows). Requesting an RPC URL, chain ID, and a signing mode is appropriate. However, the registry lists GUARDRAIL_SIGNER_ENDPOINT, GUARDRAIL_SIGNER_AUTH_TOKEN, and GUARDRAIL_DASHBOARD_API_KEY as required env vars while the SKILL.md documents the signer endpoint/auth token as only required when using the external_signer mode and the dashboard key as optional. That inconsistency is unexpected.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md explicitly limits scope to on-chain operations, read-only calls, and clearly advises against asking for private keys in chat or storing them. Instructions focus on preparing transactions and delegating signing to an external signer or user wallet, which is consistent with the stated purpose. No instructions request unrelated local files or unrelated system/cloud credentials.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction-only skill with no install spec or code files, so there is no disk install or remote code download risk from the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The number and type of env vars described in the SKILL.md are reasonable for the feature set when applied conditionally (RPC, chain ID, signing mode, and optionally signer endpoint/token and dashboard key). But the skill registry marks the signer endpoint, signer auth token, and dashboard API key as required unconditionally. Requiring an external signer endpoint and auth token when the runtime might use wallet_connector or session_key is disproportionate and increases secret-handling risk without justification.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not set to always:true and does not request to modify other skills or system-level configs. Autonomous invocation is enabled by default (disable-model-invocation:false), which is normal; nothing in the skill asks for persistent system privileges beyond standard secret access.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to implement what it claims (non-custodial ERC-4337 account management) and sensibly warns against exposing private keys. The immediate red flag is the registry metadata: it marks GUARDRAIL_SIGNER_ENDPOINT, GUARDRAIL_SIGNER_AUTH_TOKEN, and GUARDRAIL_DASHBOARD_API_KEY as required even though SKILL.md says those are conditional/optional. Before installing, ask the publisher to: (1) correct metadata so only truly required secrets are declared; (2) confirm whether signing is mandatory or optional and when the signer endpoint/token are needed; (3) provide an owner/source or homepage (registry lists unknown/none); and (4) verify how GUARDRAIL_SIGNER_AUTH_TOKEN must be scoped and rotated. If you proceed, keep the skill in read-only mode until a secure external signer or wallet-approval flow is configured, never paste private keys into chat, and store any signer/dashboard tokens in your platform's secret storage with least privilege and rotation enabled.
